title: Match the concern to the discipline
text: Nursing and Health Sciences: {{1}} Computer Science and IT: {{2}} Design and Creative Arts: {{3}} Business and Administration: {{4}} Literature and the Humanities: {{5}}

answers.1: Will students lose the clinical judgment they can only build by reasoning through cases themselves?
answers.2: Are students shipping code they can't actually explain or debug?
answers.3: Is the work still recognizably theirs if AI generated large parts of it?
answers.4: Are polished-looking reports resting on AI-fabricated data or sources?
answers.5: Is close reading and argument-building disappearing in favor of AI summaries?

distractors: Is the electricity and water cost of every query worth it?
Can we actually prove misconduct with an AI detector?
Do we have enough institutional licenses for everyone who wants to try this?
